dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave trailing edge curvature with a distinct inward spline deviation extending from the posterior dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a minimal pixel radius, resulting in a sharp vertex at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: High angular steepness of approximately 60 degrees relative to the horizontal longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.2:1 ratio of maximum pixel base width to maximum vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Moderate radius arc defining a smooth, bulbous convexity along the anterior-dorsal cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short and robust pixel length with significant thickness relative to the total cranial volume.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle of approximately 145 degrees where the descending melon slope meets the dorsal rostrum margin.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform cyan monochromatic pixel value distribution with artificial luminescent shading and lack of biological skin texture.
